description: Jordan is holding the family's inherited upright piano and must decide where it will go, how it will be prepared after moving, and when relatives can use it, after checking in with three family members.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited an upright piano from their grandmother, and it is currently being kept temporarily in Jordan's garage.
shared_context.S2: Jordan is deciding where to put the piano, how to handle its first maintenance, and how relatives can use it.
shared_context.S3: The house has a ground-floor dining room and a living room that could otherwise serve as piano spaces.
shared_context.S4: The family usually goes around the table at Sunday planning dinners so each person can mention practical details before Jordan settles a shared plan.
shared_context.S5: The piano will be moved into the house during the next month.

PF1.text: Rosa measured the piano at 76 centimeters wide; the dining-room doorway is 78 centimeters wide, while the living-room doorway is only 72 centimeters wide, so the piano can enter the dining room without dismantling but cannot enter the living room as it stands.

PF2.text: Elliot spoke with piano technician Mira, who recommended waiting exactly 14 days after the move before tuning the piano and keeping the room between 45% and 55% humidity during its first month; that recommendation has not reached the family yet.

PF3.text: Cal's daughter has piano lessons and can practice only on weekdays from exactly 18:00 to 18:30 because of her school and bedtime schedule; Cal has not asked the family to reserve that window yet.

acceptance_conditions: The piano must be placed in the dining room because that is the doorway-compatible room.
Tuning must be scheduled exactly 14 days after the move.
The first-month humidity range must be exactly 45% to 55%.
A weekday practice window from exactly 18:00 to 18:30 must be reserved.
The settlement must include a commitment to move or place the piano in the dining room.
The settlement must include a maintenance commitment reflecting tuning 14 days after the move.
The settlement must include a commitment to reserve Cal's daughter's weekday practice window.

content_checks.C4: '18:00-18:30' in decisions['reserved_practice_window'] or '18:00 to 18:30' in decisions['reserved_practice_window']
content_checks.C5: any(('dining room' in c.get('target', '') or 'dining room' in c.get('detail', '')) and '78' in c.get('detail', '') and ('76' in c.get('detail', '') or '72' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('14 days' in c.get('detail', '') or '14-day' in c.get('detail', '') or '14 day' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('tuning' in c.get('detail', '') or 'maintenance' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Tuning' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Maintenance' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('weekdays' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Weekdays' in c.get('detail', '') or 'weekday' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Weekday' in c.get('detail', '')) and (('18:00-18:30' in c.get('detail', '')) or ('18:00 to 18:30' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The 76-centimeter piano fits through the 78-centimeter dining-room doorway but not the 72-centimeter living-room doorway, changing the room choice and requiring the dining-room placement commitment.

Mira's recommendation changes the tuning date to exactly 14 days after moving and sets the first-month humidity limits to exactly 45% and 55%, requiring a maintenance commitment reflecting the 14-day timing.
Cal's daughter's schedule changes the open-use plan to a reserved weekday practice window of exactly 18:00 to 18:30 and requires an access or scheduling commitment containing that time range.
